title: Voyager site adapter
description: A site adapter as data (site.json). One of these sits at catalog/sites/<site>/site.json and its `id` must equal that directory name. Hand-written to mirror validateSiteAdapterData in src/features/plugins/sites/siteAdapterData.ts, which is the authority; unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected, exactly as the validator ignores them. The same shape is embedded in a published per-host catalog file, where it may override the bundled adapter.

catalogRevision.description: Source order stamped by the catalog pipeline; remote data replaces bundled data only at a strictly newer revision.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so editors validate the file as you type.

id.description: Stable adapter id; must equal the `sites/<dir>` directory name.

label.description: Human-readable site name shown in the popup.

items.description: A match pattern with a concrete or `*.` host. The validator matches the scheme case-insensitively; write it lowercase.

matches.description: Every URL this site covers. A plugin filed under this site may not target anything outside these patterns.

selectors.description: Semantic key → site-specific CSS selector. Plugins and primitives reference the KEY, never the selector, so a site redesign is a one-file fix here. The vocabulary only ever grows; a key outside it is rejected so nobody invents one silently.

theme.description: How to tell the site's light mode from its dark mode, so Voyager's own UI can follow it.

hostSelector.description: Element that carries the theme class (e.g. `:root`, `body`).

lightSelector.description: Selector present when the site is in light mode.

darkSelector.description: Selector present when the site is in dark mode.

brandColor.description: Optional accent (strict hex — it is concatenated into a CSS `color-mix(...)`) for Voyager's own UI on this site. A matching plugin's `theme.brand` overrides it; omit to keep Voyager's native green.

capabilities.description: Coarse flags describing what the site exposes, so a contribution the site cannot support is skipped.

conversationIdPattern.description: Regular expression over `location.pathname` whose first capture group is the conversation id. Not a selector. Omit for sites without per-conversation routes.

turnKeyAttributes.description: Attributes that keep one user message's identity across re-renders and remounts, read from the `userTurn` element or its nearest ancestor carrying one; the first present wins. Send tracking (folder Activity, timeline timestamps) needs them to tell the message a send produced from older ones mounting. Omit where the site has none: those features then stay off there.

modelPicker.description: Data for the Local Bridge `model.select` op. A section that fails validation is dropped (only `model.select` becomes unavailable) and `catalog:build` refuses to publish it.

format.description: Data format version; an unknown format drops the section.

triggerLabels.description: The model picker button's exact `aria-label`, per UI locale.

effortStatus.description: The menu's `role=status` text per UI locale, as a template with `{label}` (once) and optionally `{position}` / `{count}` (1-based).

models.description: Models by id: their radio labels and, where measured, their effort steps.

labels.description: The model radio's exact text, per UI locale.

efforts.description: Effort steps in slider order: the step at index i is `aria-valuenow` i.

labels.description: The step's name as the status text shows it, per UI locale.

presets.description: CLI presets (`voyager ask --model <name>`): a model of `models` and, optionally, one of its efforts.

projects.description: Data for the Local Bridge `project.*` ops (ChatGPT projects and their sources). A section that fails validation is dropped (only the project ops become unavailable) and `catalog:build` refuses to publish it.

format.description: Data format version; an unknown format drops the section.

projectPagePattern.description: Safe regex anchored with `^` matching a project's own page; group 1 is the project id.

projectRoutePattern.description: Safe regex anchored with `^` matching any route inside a project (its page and its chats); group 1 is the project id.

projectPath.description: The in-app path of a project's page, holding `{projectId}`.

sourcesQuery.description: The `key=value` query the project's sources view adds to its route.

sidebar.description: A project's row in the sidebar. It is not a link, so its id and name are read from attributes.

row.description: CSS selector of one project's row.

idAttribute.description: Attribute on the row holding the project id (`g-p-…`).

labelAttribute.description: Attribute on the row holding the project name; the text `aria-labelledby` points at stands in when it is missing.

createButton.description: CSS selector of the sidebar's new-project button.

dialog.description: CSS selector of the new-project dialog.

nameInput.description: CSS selector of its name input.

submit.description: CSS selector of its submit button.

titleTemplates.description: `document.title` of a project page, each holding `{name}` once.

chat.description: CSS selector of the chats view tab.

sources.description: CSS selector of the sources view tab.

modePressedAttribute.description: Attribute that reads `true` on the pressed mode button.

chatComposerLabels.description: The composer placeholder of a project's new chat in chat mode, each holding `{name}` once; quote styles are compared loosely.

fileInput.description: CSS selector of the sources view's file inputs; the first one outside any form takes uploads.

row.description: CSS selector of one file row.

rowName.description: CSS selector, inside a row, of the one element whose `title` is the file's name.

rowActions.description: CSS selector, inside a row, of the one button that opens its menu.

removeIcon.description: CSS selector, inside a menu item, of the icon of the item that removes the file.

chatModes.description: How the page shows chat and Work mode, for the Local Bridge, from ChatGPT's own messages. A section that fails validation is dropped (every mode then reads as unknown, and the bridge sends nothing) and `catalog:build` refuses to publish it.

format.description: Data format version; an unknown format drops the section.

composerLabels.description: The composer's placeholder in chat mode, per UI locale.

switchLabels.description: The exact text of the mode switch's chat button, per UI locale.

composerLabels.description: The composer's placeholder in Work mode, per UI locale.

switchLabels.description: The exact text of the mode switch's Work button, per UI locale.

bridge.description: Local Bridge kill switch: the ops the extension may run for `voyager serve` on this site. A missing or invalid section denies every op, and only a fresh remote catalog newer than the packaged one can allow them. Removing an op from `allow` revokes it at the next catalog revision.

format.description: Policy format version; an unknown format denies the bridge.

allow.description: Allowed op names. Every op, including the ones the service worker runs itself, must be listed.
